authentication: The selected authority verifier authenticates original receipt bytes and returns their digest after trust, scope and policy checks. The design fixture uses a synthetic exact receipt digest pin.
issuance: Authenticate each original receipt under its own predicate and role policy.
Decode each exact referenced artifact. Check the complete proposition and require all overlapping members to agree.
Derive the full operation input from those verified members. Preserve every receipt and immutable artifact binding used by the decision.
Issue a verified-planning-input receipt over the operation, workspace scope, source cut, exact original artifact digest and byte count.
Project solely from the verified artifact bytes. Run the selected AlchLang operation with that decoded input and its declared types.
preconditions: Expected operation, scope and cut come from trusted dispatch context. The receipt authentication capability comes from the selected trust policy. Caller-supplied input objects are never used as a second source of members.
reuse: The projected AlchLang rules compare decoded typed facts and enforce business decisions. Cryptographic and byte custody guarantees belong to the selected verifier and projection.

verified_members: expected selector and actual selector observation
complete relation manifests and edge mapping
exact proposal, intent, predecessor and successor
declared consumer universe and exact closure manifest
seven stage subjects and six handoffs
complete selected, admitted and pending target sets
exact complete check specifications including executor and fixture
both stable keys and exact immutable command tuple
revision, phase, signal and observed outcome
domain-specific past fact and source cut
terminal receipt and selector observation where applicable

receipt_subjects.closed-publication-bundle: Entire immutable bundle including its registry, index, source, target and consequence manifests, original operation and expected selector.
receipt_subjects.canonical-publication: The same complete bundle with authorized principal, action, scope, cut and expected selector.
receipt_subjects.registry-migration: Exact predecessor and postimage, approved delta, retained versions, current lookup, projections and per-entry carrier selections.
receipt_subjects.qualified-readers: Exact staged snapshot and complete declared reader universe with qualifications.
receipt_subjects.observed-publication: Original operation, complete historical bundle, actual selector before and after, resulting postimage and observed source cut.
receipt_subjects.native-effect: Original operation, exact proposal, permission, target manifest, workspace, HEAD before and after and observed outcome.
receipt_subjects.representation-fidelity: Both original body bindings, their carrier, schema and generator selections, normative digests, edge sets and exact edge mapping.
receipt_subjects.owner-disposition: Exact reviewed bodies or proposal, role assignment, scope, cut, and decision.
receipt_subjects.lifecycle-review: Exact lifecycle proposal containing intent, predecessor, successor, original operation and reviewed effect scope.
receipt_subjects.impact-closure: Exact lifecycle proposal and complete consumer universe, closure manifest, cursors, limits and unresolved outcomes.
receipt_subjects.lifecycle-permission: Same exact lifecycle proposal, verified impact closure, principal, permission scope and operation.
receipt_subjects.complete-selection: Full selected definition and obligation manifest, exact admitted and pending partition, seven subjects, six handoffs and check specifications.
receipt_subjects.definition-selection: Exact selected meanings, applicability, scopes and standing for all referenced versions.
receipt_subjects.construction-compatibility: Exact route, applicable prototype selection and complete inherited compatibility requirements.
receipt_subjects.resolved-capabilities: Exact language/profile, native closure and resolved resource bindings.
receipt_subjects.construction-entry: Entire entry record including selected manifest, exact check specs, input stages, compatibility and native/profile selections.
receipt_subjects.independent-conformance: Exact entry receipt, complete output manifest, all per-spec results, actual assessor and independence evidence.
receipt_subjects.stable-join-identity: Workspace, durable run reference, original operation, both numeric keys, and exact immutable command tuple.
receipt_subjects.join-transition: Workspace, run, operation, both keys, original cut, revision, prior phase, signal, observed outcome and complete domain-specific past fact.
receipt_subjects.join-completed: Exact final journal record with stable run and operation identity, both keys, final revision, committed/replayed native and publication receipts, published snapshot and observed source transition.
receipt_subjects.join-refused: Exact final refusal journal record with original operation and keys, refusal past fact, revision and all existing effects. It cannot claim a committed canonical publication was refused.

binding_format: An original artifact binding identifies exact original bytes by SHA-256 and byte count. A receipt must bind its complete subject under the selected predicate. Reusing the same reference with different bytes changes the binding. The projected artifact includes the original receipt and artifact references in its typed input.

additional_operation_requirements.BeginJoinPlan: Authenticate the complete stable-join-identity assignment for the exact command and both keys. Bind the original Proposed observation and revision to the same run and cut before dispatching the candidate transaction.
additional_operation_requirements.ReadJoinRun: Derive the id and workspace from verified historical identity resolution. Bind the read authority to that exact tuple.
additional_operation_requirements.PlanJoinContinuation: Bind the persisted phase and current revision to the original operation, cut and full observed native/publication outcome receipts. Recovery and terminal replay read the same journal record.
additional_operation_requirements.ReviewFiveDefinitions: Bind the complete five-target selection and every applicable original disposition to exact bytes and their expected review scope.
additional_operation_requirements.AssessExecutionContext: Bind the workspace, selected runtime, custody, store, linked Project/Work and current cut to the original verified context.
additional_operation_requirements.PlanCreationRoute: Bind the exact verified context, selected compiled entry and original creation body. Preparation produces an unsigned candidate plan.

dispatch: Apply the checked projection to every evidence-bearing call. The generated pure operation is the decision kernel. The application may invoke it only with the projected value. Kernel unit checks call the generated operation directly to isolate decision behavior.
